decision: PHASE 10A4 PRE2 PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS

runtimeVariablePresence.method: boolean presence only; no value, length, hash, or derivative read or emitted

previewAccess.urlResolutionMethod: public GitHub deployment-status API for the frontend commit (Vercel CLI/token not provisioned to this environment); private Preview URL captured to a transient local file, never printed, deleted at cleanup
previewAccess.deploymentSelected: GitHub deployment environment 'Preview - tina-ai' for commit 1748788
previewAccess.unauthenticatedMeaning: redirect to Vercel SSO; Deployment Protection genuinely enforced
previewAccess.authorizedBypassMechanism: x-vercel-protection-bypass header (from env) + x-vercel-set-bypass-cookie handshake, cookie persisted in a transient jar

previewBackendTarget.method: fetched the Preview production JS bundle with the authorized bypass cookie and searched for backend hosts
previewBackendTarget.conclusion: Preview build compiles in the staging backend only; the alternate/production host is absent from the shipped bundle

stagingSmoke.noteColdStart: an initial POST /login returned a connection-level failure (no HTTP response) consistent with Render free-tier cold start; the request succeeded on warm retry

security.correlationIdentifiers: one-way SHA-256-derived synthetic conversation ref only

findings.title: Preview URL resolution depends on the public GitHub deployment-status API
findings.impact: No Vercel CLI session or token is provisioned to the agent environment, so the private Preview URL was resolved via GitHub. Acceptable for read-only access, but a first-party Vercel bypass-URL provisioning path would be more robust and auditable.

findings.title: Two parallel Vercel projects (tina-ai and tina) deploy Previews for the same commit
findings.impact: Carried from PRE1. tina-ai was selected as canonical by name match. Duplication should be resolved as a governance cleanup item.

findings.title: Render staging exhibits free-tier cold-start connection resets
findings.impact: First heavy POST after idle can fail at the connection level and needs a warm retry; smoke harnesses should tolerate one cold-start retry.
